# Product Designer II (Commerce) — Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology

---
**Job ID:** 10160859
**Date Posted:** Nov 6, 2026
**Date Applied:** Nov 7, 2026
**Salary Range:** Not stated (the posting's pay transparency section is blank); available in 2 locations, New York, NY listed
---

## Job Summary

A Product Designer II on Disney Streaming's Growth and Commerce team, which owns the conversion funnels of the subscriber journey: how viewers discover, sign up for, pay for, and stay with Disney+ and Hulu across web, mobile, and living-room devices. The role owns end-to-end design for a domain of that journey (sign-up and checkout, plan selection, offers and promotions), works independently with product managers and engineers, and mentors more junior designers.

---

## What You'll Do

- Own end-to-end design within a domain of the subscriber growth journey, from problem framing through shipped, measured experiences, checking in with a Lead or Senior designer at key milestones.
- Drive the full design process: user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups.
- Extend and evolve the design system, contributing components and patterns and defining deltas between web, mobile, and living-room devices.
- Partner with Product Managers and Engineers from the earliest stages, shaping feature definition and scope.
- Own design delivery to engineering and QA: specs, redlines, edge cases, and states across platforms.
- Design for accessibility from the outset (contrast, focus order, screen reader support, remote-based navigation).
- Help define A/B and multivariate experimentation strategy and synthesize results.
- Build an evidence-based design instinct from research, usability testing, and product metrics.
- Use AI-assisted tools as a core part of the workflow for exploration, prototyping, and synthesis.
- Mentor junior designers and present work in critiques and reviews.

### Required Qualifications
- 3+ years in product design, UX design, or a design-related field, with a track record of shipping complex features end-to-end
- A portfolio demonstrating strong UX and visual design craft, deep process, and measurable outcomes at scale
- Strong proficiency in Figma, including component systems and advanced interactive prototyping
- Solid grounding in user-centered design methodologies, applied independently
- Working knowledge of accessible design practices and WCAG standards
- Experience using AI-assisted tools as a core part of the design process
- Exceptional written, verbal, interpersonal, and presentation skills, including mentoring or giving feedback to designers
- Nice to have: conversion, e-commerce, subscription, or growth design; designing and analyzing A/B or multivariate tests; living-room devices (Apple TV, Roku, Xbox, PlayStation, Fire TV); evolving an established design system at scale; global or localized markets

### Education
A degree or certification in UX Design, Product Design, HCI, Communication Design, or Graphic Design, or equivalent practical experience; Bachelor's degree required.

### Benefits
Not stated in the posting.

---

## How I Match Up

### At Application — Nov 7, 2026

- **End-to-end shipped design:** ExtrusionStudio's interface was designed per audience (projector view, a touch screen per line, packing-bench panel, statistics TV) and has been live since October 2026; print-on-demand labels removed up to about 30% of label waste per run. The ICARUS-Lite was designed and developed end to end for minimal customer setup, with a bolt-less shell carrying the POSEIDON's design language.
- **Design system and accessibility:** this site's Blueprint Press system (tokens, ten palettes, dark mode as a token swap, one shared easing curve), reduced-motion support, focus-visible states, and ARIA labels in the site code, and the interactive HTML resume layer verified in light, dark, and at 390px with JavaScript off.
- **AI-assisted workflow is a strong match:** Claude Code builds and maintains the site; repository agent skills tailor resumes, sync documentation, and decide motion; an impeccable critique and anti-pattern skill checks design work against written product and design context.
- **Gaps:** no professional product-design title or design portfolio of consumer UX at scale; no Figma; no A/B or multivariate testing, usability testing, or design research on the record; no WCAG audit; no commerce, subscription, or growth work; no living-room device design; no mentoring of designers. No design degree or certification (the B.S. is Electro-Mechanical Engineering). These were kept out of the resume, which frames the evidence as engineering-led product design.
- **Fit:** a stretch; the "3+ years of product design" and Figma requirements are the likeliest screen-outs.

### Now — Nov 7, 2026

Nothing has changed since the application.

## About the Company

Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is the global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, and data scientists behind Disney's media business, including Disney+, Hulu, ESPN, ABC, and ABC News. Its Design group is responsible for design across consumer-facing and business products and tooling, including sports, entertainment, enterprise, UX, creative services, and design research. The position is with Disney Entertainment & Sports LLC.
